items.d:
Only ruins are left here, but all is not lost.
<Set Effect> Random several nodes grant 2x base resource production every 2 rounds
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Food, firewood, and medicine. Help from good neighbors and 'good neighbors' have arrived together.
<Set Effect> Random several nodes grant 2x base resource production every 2 rounds
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Hey, look what we found!
<Set Effect> All nodes' resource types are reset at random every 2 rounds
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Some things matter more. You win some, you lose some.
<Set Effect> Every 2 rounds, 4 random nodes lock and yield no resources; others grant more resources
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

She said, 'Remember the path you walked, and let not yourself forget.'
<Set Effect> All nodes start with reduced base production; each time you complete a full lap, all nodes' base resource production +1
<Repair Plan Range> 1-3 (random)

Look down and harvest the fruits of the earth; look up and catch the stars.
<Set Effect> Chests appear in random nodes every 2 rounds and last for 2 rounds; passing them grants random resources
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Creating a list of unfinished work does wonders for efficiency.
<Set Effect> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Repair Plan for every 2 Reconstruction Points earned (max +4)
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Almost there!
<Set Effect> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Repair Plan for every 2 Reconstruction Points earned (max +4)
All nodes' resource types are reset at random every 2 rounds
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Last check—nothing loose or left behind.
<Set Effect> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Plan for every 2 Points earned (max +4)
Every 2 rounds, 4 random nodes lock and yield no resources; others grant more resources
<Repair Plan Range> 1-5 (random)

Spring's come to Kjerag as promised.
<Set Effect> All nodes' base production reduced; +2 after every full lap
Chests appear in random nodes every 2 rounds and last for 2 rounds; passing them grants random resources
<Repair Plan Range> 1-3 (random)
The numbers don't line up? Let me see the repair plan.
Oh... Well, don't get discouraged. Let's do it again, together.
Kjeragandr guides our path...
You must advance once before collecting resources. In addition, using Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers during resource collection can improve collection efficiency.

Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers can be used consecutively while collecting resources, and each consecutive use grants an additional amount of all resource types. Make good use of this.
Completion, information, and personnel... you handle everything very well, Doctor.
Ah, you're that dok... dok... dok-something that the Saintess was talking about? My neighbors asked me to bring you some toffee. Enjoy, and thanks for everything you've done!
Welcome, ally. Repair progress? Oh, we know you'll do a good job of it. Our time can be used on more productive things.
It's been a while, Doctor. Thank you for your help. Come to the Vine-Bead Court for dinner when you have the time. The clerics are looking forward to talking to someone as learned as you.
A reasonable result. Lacking in surprises, pleasant or otherwise, but sometimes compromise is the best option.
